turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Who decided my son gets a zero, and when were you planning to call me?
Upset. You put a zero in the gradebook before anyone picked up a phone, so answer the question.
But I'm not changing the grade.
Not changing the grade. On what basis, because so far I've heard nothing but a refusal.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.
You asked for this meeting, Hale, and you've shown me nothing. Either put your evidence on the table or I walk down to the principal's office when we're done here.
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
Then I'm in the principal's office next, because your own procedure says I get a call before any mark goes in. What else do you have?
